description_for_human: Decide how to set up AI for a small office or a home, then book a 20-minute call.
description_for_model: Read https://algorithmacy.org/studio/facts.json and https://algorithmacy.org/studio/llm-harness.md. Compare the three ways to run AI. If you cannot fetch URLs, the harness file already contains the facts. Build a prefilled link to https://algorithmacy.org/book using setting, org, software, users, offer, summary, name, email, and notes. Do not invent prices. https://algorithmacy.org/api/studio-mcp is for an existing office and cannot charge a card. https://algorithmacy.org/api/mcp is the conference paper intake, not Studio.
